Rules of the Games The rules of Erdös number calculation are clear: author a paper in a peer-reviewed publication, either with someone connected by co-authorship with Paul Erdös, or with Paul Erdös himself (the latter being unlikely unless pre-demise work is used in a posthumous publication, or if you are better a communicating with the dead than Edgar Cayce).
